comments:
Title reported in [8H6M69W4]: No. 15677: dbu ma'i yig cha phya pas byas pa.
The 82-folio manuscript with the signature "tsa 107" reported in [HMSTSJ7Q]: 71, with the colophon corresponding to that of the dBu ma snang ba'i 'grel pa (ID:4882) might correspond to this instance, or to instance (ID:4481), the title of which is also reported as "dbu ma'i yig cha" in [8H6M69W4]: No. 7281.
